name: TaskEvent
description: Event timeline for a Task. Each row records a state transition or progress message at a specific timestamp. Drives task progress UIs and post-mortem inspection. ACL is read-only via generic CRUD: events are emitted by TaskService and the scheduler — direct writes would forge the lifecycle stream.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner — denormalized from the parent Task (52-D doc). Populated by the task runtime on event publish. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter (52-D.2 / 52-D.3).

attributes.name: conversationId
attributes.description: Agent conversation id (cid) this event belongs to, when the task is an agent turn; null for functions. Lets events be traced across all of a conversation's turn-tasks.
